newsitem.title: UK: Japanese spend most on general insurance - report.
newsitem.headline: Japanese spend most on general insurance - report.

text.p: The Japanese spend more per head on personal general insurance than any other nationality, management consultant Datamonitor said on Monday.
Its new global insurance rankings show that the Japanese spend around $1,000 a year each on such insurance, with Switzerland in second place and Austria in third.
However, while these and other developed economies offer limited future growth to insurers, new opportunities are cropping up elsewhere, it added.
"Political, economic and regulatory changes are creating opportunities for insurance companies around the world," Datamonitor said in a statement.
"As growth in the European and North American insurance markets slows down and as competitive intensity increases, insurers are becoming increasingly keen to take advantage of new opportunities."
